selections.title:
A good solution starts
with a better conversation.
selections.question: Who is doing the work — and what do they wish someone understood?

selections.label: The technology perspective
selections.title:
The tool should fit
the work. Not the reverse.

selections.title:
The same task.
Again. And again.
selections.question: Where does the work stop moving — and who has to pick it up?
